blueShop.item.merge_all.desc.en: Merges every pair on the floor you're looking at

tutorial.prestige.blue.en: You can reincarnate! You start over, but with Blue that multiplies everything forever.

tutorial.tip.blue.en: Your first Blue! Trade it in Upgrades for a permanent boost

upgrades.flavor.lucky.es: Cada tanto un toque sale premiado, y muy de vez en cuando, uno dorado.
upgrades.flavor.lucky.en: Every so often a tap comes out lucky, and once in a blue moon, golden.
